map.熵变（ΔS = Q_rev / T） 使用指南: Entropy Change (ΔS = Q_rev / T) - User Guide
map.输入可逆传热量 Q_rev 与系统温度 T，按 ΔS=Q_rev/T 计算可逆相: Enter reversible heat Q_rev and system temperature T; compute entropy change of reversible phase change or heat transfer by ΔS=Q_rev/T, for the second law and reversibility assessment.
map.可逆相变或传热过程的熵变等于可逆热量除以温度。: Entropy change of a reversible phase change or heat transfer equals reversible heat divided by temperature.
map.可逆传热下的熵变 ΔS=Q/T。: Entropy change under reversible heat transfer: ΔS=Q/T.
map.与孤立系统熵增原理联动。: Linked with the isolated-system entropy increase principle.
map.：Q=4186 J（1g 水汽化潜热）, T=373.15 K：ΔS=4186/: : Q=4186 J (latent heat of 1 g water vaporization), T=373.15 K: ΔS = 4186/373.15 = 11.22 J/K.
map.由系统与外界熵变求熵产: Entropy generation from system and surroundings
map.可逆相变在恒温 T 下进行，用此绝对温度 K。: Reversible phase change occurs at constant T; use absolute temperature K.
map.不可逆时 ΔS>Q/T，须按可逆路径计算状态函数差。: When irreversible, ΔS>Q/T; state function differences must be computed along a reversible path.
